question: Hello, I am in the process of applying to the Cybersecurity and Business Bachelor’s degree and would like to confirm a few details. I am an EU citizen but currently living in Portugal and finishing high school with an International Baccalaureate diploma. Do I still need to apply via Uni-Assist, or is there a different process for IB graduates? Furthermore, is there a separate motivation letter required for this specific program?
reference_answer:
Dear ... ,

Thank you for your interest in the Cybersecurity and Business Bachelor’s degree program at HTW Berlin!

Regarding your application process as an EU citizen with an International Baccalaureate (IB) diploma, you do **not** need to apply via Uni-Assist. As an EU citizen, you apply directly through our HTW Berlin application portal. 

You can find the application portal and detailed instructions here: [https://cyber-security-business.htw-berlin.de/application/](https://cyber-security-business.htw-berlin.de/application/)

Regarding a motivation letter, a separate motivation letter is **not** required for the Cybersecurity and Business program. However, you will be asked to upload a statement of purpose within the online application form. This statement should explain your motivation for choosing this specific program and highlight your relevant skills and experiences.

Please ensure you submit all required documents, including proof of English proficiency, by the application deadline. The application period for the winter semester is typically from May 15th to July 15th, but please check the website for the most up-to-date dates. 

You can find more information on the admission requirements here: [https://cyber-security-business.htw-berlin.de/application/admission-requirements/](https://cyber-security-business.htw-berlin.de/application/admission-requirements/)

If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We wish you all the best with your application!

Sincerely,

HTW Berlin Student Services
staff_comment: "Statement of purpose" not required. Everything else is fine.

question: I am currently in the process of finalizing my application via Uni-Assist for the upcoming winter semester. However, I am facing some confusion regarding the document submission deadlines and whether hard copies need to be sent by post, or if digital uploads are sufficient. Additionally, could you please confirm whether the application portal requires certified translations of all academic transcripts at this stage, or only upon admission?
reference_answer:
Dear prospective applicant,

Thank you for your interest in studying at HTW Berlin and for reaching out with your questions regarding the application process.

Regarding your document submission, please note that **all documents must be uploaded digitally via the Uni-Assist platform.** There is no need to send hard copies by post. 

Concerning certified translations, **we require certified translations of all academic transcripts *at the time of application* through Uni-Assist.** Please ensure these are uploaded alongside your original transcripts. Uni-Assist will verify these documents as part of their initial assessment.

Please remember the application deadline for the winter semester is **July 15th**. We strongly advise you to upload all required documents, including certified translations, well in advance of this date to avoid any potential issues.

You can find detailed information on required documents and the application procedure on our website:

[https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/)

If you have further questions or encounter any difficulties during the application process, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

We wish you the best of luck with your application!
staff_comment: Correct, the only mistake is the deadline (June 30th, not July 15th - this is only on uniassist)

question: My name is Ananya and I’m currently completing my final year in BBA at the University of Delhi. I would like to apply for the Master’s in International Business starting this fall. Given that I will only receive my final semester results in mid-July, would I still be eligible to apply within the regular deadlines? Could you please let me know how pending transcripts are handled during the application review?
reference_answer:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master’s in International Business program at HTW Berlin!

We understand you are completing your BBA at the University of Delhi and will receive your final semester results in mid-July. Regarding your eligibility to apply despite pending transcripts, please note the following:

For the fall semester (winter semester) intake, the application period via uni-assist is generally from April 15th to July 15th. You are welcome to apply within this timeframe, even if your final transcript is not yet available. 

However, please be aware that your application will only be considered complete once we have received your official transcript. We can accept a preliminary transcript or a letter from your university confirming your expected graduation date as a temporary measure during the application process. *Please upload this alongside your application.*

**Important:** If you are offered a place, the final admission is contingent upon receiving your official, complete transcript. We would need to receive this by August 31st at the latest.

You can find more detailed information about the application process on our website: 
https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master/for-applicants/application/ 

Also, please refer to these helpful links:
http://mib.htw-berlin.de/
http://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/applying-with-foreign-certificates/ 

If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,

question: Dear Admissions Team, I am a dual citizen (French and Moroccan), currently residing in Morocco and holding a French Baccalauréat diploma. I want to apply for the English-taught Bachelor’s in Business but am unsure whether I should apply as an EU applicant or international. Also, would my French diploma fulfill the general university entrance requirements, or would I need to obtain a VPD from Uni-Assist?
reference_answer:
Dear prospective applicant,

Thank you for your request and your interest in HTW Berlin.

Regarding your application status, as a dual citizen of France and Morocco, you can apply as an EU applicant. Please indicate your French citizenship during the application process.

Concerning your French Baccalauréat, it is necessary to check whether it fulfills the general university entrance requirements for Germany. Please use the Anabin database to verify its eligibility:

[https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/schulabschluesse-mit-hochschulzugang.html](https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/schulabschluesse-mit-hochschulzugang.html)

If Anabin confirms your diploma qualifies for direct university entry in Germany, you do *not* need a VPD (Verwendungsbescheinigung) from uni-assist. However, if Anabin indicates further assessment is needed, you *will* need to apply through uni-assist and request a VPD.

Please note the application deadlines for the winter semester are typically in July. For the most up-to-date information, please consult our application page: [https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/)

You can find more information about the Bachelor’s in Business program here: [https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/](https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/)

Should you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.
staff_comment: Everything is correct, except double check VPD.
